summary: District 120 argues against sunset, rural‑only limits, and MIBS exclusion while supporting continued E‑Rate funding, local control of screen time, and consultant fee restrictions. District 120 argues for keeping Managed Internal Broadband Services (MIBS) eligible with safeguards, opposes federal screen‑time limits, supports local control of technology use, and calls for consultant fee rules that protect integrity without harming small districts.
